pages.sidebarCurrent: Generate Anki Basic and Cloze flashcards
pages.mainText:
Generate Anki Basic and Cloze flashcards

Generate Anki Basic (question-and-answer) and Cloze (fill-in-the-blank) cards from code instead of adding them one at a time in Anki. A Basic note has a front and back. A Cloze note generates one card for each supported deletion number. This Rust example creates two notes and three cards. Python and Node.js provide the same Note.basic and Note.cloze constructors; see the Python API and Node API.

From the repository root:

Terminal window
cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples

Open target/docs-examples/cards.apkg in Anki. The Basic question is hola; the Cloze cards separately hide Madrid and Spain.

Author the notes
Section titled “Author the notes”

This function is extracted from the complete executable. Its verify helper checks the successful output’s note/card/media counts.

fn cards(output: &Path) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let mut project = Project::new("docs-spanish")?.default_deck("Spanish");
    project.add("hola", Note::basic("hola", "hello"))?;
    project.add(
        "capital",
        Note::cloze("{{c1::Madrid}} is in {{c2::Spain}}.")
            .field("back_extra", "A city and its country."),
    )?;
    let built = project.build(BuildOptions::to(output.join("cards.apkg")))?;
    verify(&built, 2, 3, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

The first argument to Project::new is a stable namespace. Each add call needs a stable source-record key. Reusing one key for another note fails; no automatic content-based key is assigned. A changed answer under the same key remains the same logical note when building an update from its previous distribution.

Text, fields and card identity
Section titled “Text, fields and card identity”

Both Basic and Cloze strings are Text. Use Content::html for intentional HTML; Cloze deletion syntax is still recognized inside Text. back_extra is the built-in Cloze extra field key. Use the same Note::field method for text, HTML, images and sounds.

Use {{c1::answer}} or {{c1::answer::hint}}. A plain sentence supplies no Cloze question. Supported deletion numbers are 1–500; changing numbers can alter card identities. Review such changes through comparison and update policy.

landed.sectionText:
Entry	Behavior
Project(namespace, *, default_deck=None)	Validates the explicit stable namespace and configures the default deck
project.add(key, note)	Atomically collects the note, model and owned media; duplicate note keys fail
project.add_asset(media)	Includes an explicit raw HTML/CSS/script dependency
len(project)	Number of successfully added notes
Note.basic(front, back)	Built-in Basic model; strings mean Text
Note.cloze(text)	Built-in Cloze model; strings mean Text and retain cloze syntax
note.field(key, content)	Returns a new note with the field assignment; key validation occurs on add
note.deck(name) / .tag(tag) / .tags(tags)	Returns a configured note
note.note_type	The immutable owned model
Ordinary strings become Text. Content.text(value) and Content.html(value) are explicit constructors; Content.sequence(iterable) composes strings and content without rendering or losing media dependencies. A field does not accept a raw filename as a media reference.

pages.description: Add images and audio to generated Anki cards with Rust, Python or Node.js. Import files, compose card content, and manage export names, MIME types and budgets.
pages.opening: Package images and audio into generated Anki cards, such as vocabulary cards with pronunciation audio or diagram questions. The examples use Rust; batch import below also shows the Python and Node.js calls.
pages.sidebarCurrent: Add images and audio to Anki cards
pages.mainText:
Add images and audio to Anki cards Package images and audio into generated Anki cards, such as vocabulary cards with pronunciation audio or diagram questions. Anki Forge copies the files you provide into the APKG; creating the audio or images, for example with text-to-speech, requires a separate tool. The examples use Rust; batch import below also shows the Python and Node.js calls. A Media value owns an immutable snapshot. Import files with Media::file or native bytes with an explicit MIME type via Media::bytes. After successful import, modifying or deleting the source file cannot change the asset. Clones share storage and can be used across projects. Execute the media workflow Section titled “Execute the media workflow” From the repository root: Terminal window cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_media The workflow uses repository PNG/WAV fixtures and writes media.apkg with one note, one card and three assets. The second example generates its own tiny image and audio, includes CSS-linked and explicit media, and writes spanish-media.apkg. fn media(output: &Path, image: &Path, sound: &Path) -> anyhow::Result<()> { let image = Media::file(image)?.with_export_name("cell.png")?; let sound = Media::file(sound)?; let mut project = Project::new("docs-media")?; project.add("cell", Note::basic(image.image(), sound.sound()))?; let css = Media::bytes(b".card { color: navy; }".to_vec(), "text/css")? .with_export_name("course.css")?; project.add_asset(css)?; let built = project.build(BuildOptions::to(output.join("media.apkg")))?; verify(&built, 1, 1, 3)?; Ok(()) } Compose content and explicit assets Section titled “Compose content and explicit assets” This complete program uses fixtures/pixel.png, fixtures/silence.wav, and fixtures/labels.woff. In your application, pass your own source paths. The fixture font is the repository’s redistributable test font. use ankiforge::{BuildOptions, Content, Field, Media, NoteType, Project, Template}; fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> { let image = Media::file("fixtures/pixel.png")?.with_export_name("badge.png")?; let sound = Media::file("fixtures/silence.wav")?; let font = Media::file("fixtures/labels.woff")?.with_export_name("labels.woff")?; let model = NoteType::builder("media-card") .field(Field::new("front")) .field(Field::new("back")) .template(Template::new("card") .front(r#"{{front}}"#) .back("{{FrontSide}}
{{back}}")) .css("@font-face { font-family: labels; src: url('labels.woff'); } .card { font-family: labels; }") .asset(font) .asset(image.clone()) .build()?; let mut project = Project::new("media-guide")?; project.add("cell", model.note() .field("front", Content::sequence([Content::text("Cell "), image.image()])) .field("back", sound.sound()))?; let output = project.build(BuildOptions::to("media-guide.apkg"))?; assert_eq!(output.report().counts().media, 3); Ok(()) } Typed image() and sound() values retain dependencies until export. Manual HTML/CSS/script references need builder.asset(media) or project.add_asset(media); the library does not infer file contents from arbitrary strings. An explicit asset is included even without a statically detectable reference. Pass the literal filename to with_export_name. Typed sound references escape HTML entities when rendered, so a name such as tone©.mp3 still refers to that exact asset. Do not pre-escape the filename. Percent signs and fragment characters in sound filenames remain literal; they are not URL paths. Names, MIME and budgets Section titled “Names, MIME and budgets” Default export names are content-derived and independent of the source path. Use with_export_name before creating references when a fixed filename is needed. Renaming a clone does not rename earlier clones or content nodes. Names cannot contain paths, controls or nonportable reserved names. Conflict checks use Unicode NFC plus case folding: case-only or normalization-only variants also conflict. Exactly identical name/content pairs are idempotent; different contents under one name fail without partial registration. The complete export filename, including its extension, is limited to 255 UTF-8 bytes. Project and template-bundle JSON Schemas check filename syntax and character count; the loaders additionally check this byte budget. For example, 128 repetitions of é pass the schema’s character limit but occupy 256 bytes and return MEDIA.EXPORT_NAME_INVALID when loaded. Use tools::load_project or NoteType::from_bundle to validate the complete input before building. MIME syntax and identifiable content must agree. Native bytes have no 64 KiB inline restriction. The default import budget is 256 MiB per asset; file_with_limits and bytes_with_limits accept MediaLimits { max_bytes } before reading. Large snapshots may spill to temporary storage, cleaned up when the last owner disappears. Snapshot ownership does not promise an atomic filesystem view of a source being modified concurrently during import. Project JSON applies the same default per-asset budget while decoding an inline bytes array. It stops at the first excess byte without collecting the rest of the array, and retains a MediaError with the limit and observed byte count. The count at rejection is a lower bound; it is not the unread array’s total size. A valid media package does not prove codec playback on every Anki client. Test images, sound and fonts on your target clients. See troubleshooting. Typed image and sound usage Section titled “Typed image and sound usage” Constructors stay infallible. Project::add checks the retained import MIME: images require image/*, sound references accept audio/* and video/*. application/octet-stream, text, fonts and PDF fail typed usage with NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID; register them as explicit assets for raw HTML/CSS. Valid explicit unknown image/video MIME declarations pass category validation, without certifying that a decoder or player supports the bytes. Renaming a file never changes retained MIME. Build still sniffs staged bytes and validates the export extension independently: PNG named wrong.mp3 can pass image addition and fail build with MEDIA.DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH. Batch media import Section titled “Batch media import” These methods are included in the public 0.3.1 package. Import a collection with bounded concurrency, keep input order, and retain owned media snapshots for later export: use ankiforge::Media; let images = Media::files(["first.png", "second.png"])?; Node uses await Media.files(['first.png', 'second.png']); Python uses Media.files(['first.png', 'second.png']). Batch behavior and budgets Section titled “Batch behavior and budgets” Use Media::files(paths) in Rust, await Media.files(paths) in Node, or Media.files(paths) in Python to import files in input order with at most four workers per call. Batches below 16 files run serially. Rust also provides files_with_limits; Node and Python accept the same limits as file. The limit applies to each asset. If an import fails, the call waits for started work, drops the batch’s snapshots, and returns the first error in input order. Existing media owners remain valid. Python releases the GIL during import; Node performs the work off the event loop. Single-file imports remain immediate owned snapshots; callers must opt into the batch method for import concurrency. Live snapshots share a 64 MiB process-wide memory budget. Individual assets larger than 1 MiB still stream to temporary files. Encoded media share a lazily allocated 16 MiB buffer pool per preparation and spill when it fills. These budgets exclude other working memory and are not an RSS cap; concurrent builds can each own an encoding pool. """Generate and review an answer-only update from caller-parsed JSON."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from ankiforge import BuildOptions, CompareOptions, Content, Media, Note, Project


def project(source: Path, version: str) -> Project:
    data = json.loads((source / version).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    image = Media.file(source / 'cell.png')
    audio = Media.file(source / 'tone.wav')
    result = Project(data['namespace'], default_deck=data['deck'])
    for row in data['notes']:
        front = Content.sequence([row['front'], image.image(), audio.sound()])
        result.add(row['id'], Note.basic(front, row['back']))
    return result


source = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'recipe')
output = Path(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'output/python')
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
baseline, candidate = output / 'v1.apkg', output / 'v2.apkg'
if baseline.exists() or candidate.exists():
    raise RuntimeError('Choose a fresh output directory; keep original releases')
project(source, 'v1.json').build(BuildOptions.to(baseline))
next_project = project(source, 'v2.json')
comparison = next_project.compare(CompareOptions.against(baseline))
(output / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparison.snapshot(), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
if not comparison.allows_publication:
    raise RuntimeError('Comparison policy blocked publication; inspect comparison.json')
prepared = next_project.prepare_publication(BuildOptions.to(candidate).update_from(baseline))
try:
    review = prepared.report.comparison
    if review is None:
        raise RuntimeError('Missing update comparison')
    (output / 'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(review.snapshot(), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    if not review.allows_publication:
        raise RuntimeError('Prepared candidate blocked; inspect review.json')
    result = prepared.publish()
    print(result.artifact.path)
finally:
    prepared.close()

landed.sectionText:
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError
project = Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'))
previous = project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'))
previous.artifact.close()
prepared = project.prepare_publication(
    BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').update_from('previous.apkg')
)
try:
    report = prepared.report  # observations; does not own the candidate
    if report.comparison is None or report.comparison.allows_publication:
        output = prepared.publish()
        output.artifact.close()  # persistent next.apkg remains
except BuildError as error:
    print(error.snapshot()['result'])  # actual publication/durability facts
    raise
finally:
    prepared.close()  # idempotent; deletes an unused candidate
One publish attempt consumes the owner, including policy or I/O failure. Later calls raise PreparedPublicationStateError with code BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE and reason closed or consumed; close does not cancel an already running publication. Relative paths bind at preparation invocation, and Project changes cannot modify the reviewed APKG. Reports survive close without retaining files. Change options or retry by preparing again. Duration excludes review waiting. Late errors can mean replacement succeeded with unconfirmed durability; inspect publication facts before deciding what to do. Native binding protocol 1 and contract bundle 2.1.0 are required; older same-version binaries are rejected.

pages.mainText:
Troubleshooting

Use the structured kind and code from the failing operation, plus its source chain and observations. Display text is for humans and may change. A failed operation and a completed comparison whose policy blocks publication are different results.

Installation
Section titled “Installation”
Symptom	Check
Rust rejects the toolchain	Run rustc --version; use Rust 1.92+ and check cargo tree -i ankiforge for the installed version
Node cannot load its native package	Run node -p "process.platform + '/' + process.arch" and npm ls ankiforge; reinstall with npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1
Node reports a native/wrapper mismatch	Use matching package versions; reinstall from the same registry version, or rebuild both from the same checkout
Python cannot load its extension	Run python -m pip show ankiforge and python -m pip debug --verbose; check interpreter and wheel OS/CPU tags
Python selects a source distribution	Choose a matching wheel/interpreter, or follow source builds with a compiler

See verified environments, Node setup and Python setup.

Models and notes
Section titled “Models and notes”
Symptom	Correction
Invalid or empty key	Supply an explicit stable key; display names are separate
NOTE.KEY_DUPLICATE	Give each logical source record one unique key
NOTE.FIELD_UNKNOWN	Assign the field’s key, not its display name
NOTE.FIELD_REQUIRED	Fill fields declared required() before adding
NOTE.MODEL_CONFLICT	Reuse the same completed model for one model key
Template reference error	Use declared keys in templates; inspect the original source byte range
HTML appears literally	Use Content::html only for intentional markup
Missing Cloze cards	Supply {{c1::answer}} syntax with supported numbers 1–500

An add failure is atomic. Correct the note/model and retry; no partial model or media registration needs to be undone. Model builders must finish with .build() before they can create custom notes.

Media and templates
Section titled “Media and templates”
Symptom	Correction
File import fails	Check the source at Media::file time; later source deletion is supported
MIME/content mismatch	Pass the actual MIME type to the bytes constructor
Export-name conflict	Choose unique portable names; case and Unicode normalization variants conflict
Missing raw HTML/CSS/script resource	Declare it with model asset or project add_asset
Media import exceeds a limit	Explicitly raise MediaLimits.max_bytes before importing
Build inspection exceeds a limit	Adjust the relevant InspectLimits counter for this operation
Bundle load fails	Use bundle-v2, explicit keys, key-based templates and paths within the bundle
IO rectangle fails	Check decoded display dimensions, finite coordinates and unique mask keys

Text defaults are uniform across all note kinds. Media nodes collect dependencies; manually writing a filename does not import its bytes. A valid package still requires client playback checks for the codec/font you intend to use.

Updates and outputs
Section titled “Updates and outputs”

Use an original distribution APKG containing complete identity evidence as the baseline. Anki re-exported packages do not retain that evidence. A namespace mismatch or corrupt evidence cannot be accepted by an update policy.

A completed comparison can have allows_publication == false. Inspect original findings and evidence before selecting an explicit risk-category allowance. Do not blanket-allow every result. The same policy must be passed to the actual update build if you want the same decision. A policy on a create-only request is an error.

If a temporary path disappeared, retain its output/artifact owner until all readers finish. Reports and JSON snapshots are not owners. For persistence failures, inspect the error’s publication stage and durability: an error can be returned after a destination was already published. See output guarantees.

用 Rust 生成 Anki 卡片

使用 Rust 1.92 或更高版本。其他语言可选择 Node / TypeScript 或 Python。

安装
章节：安装
终端窗口
cargo new anki-deck
cd anki-deck
cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1

导出第一个牌组
章节：导出第一个牌组

将这份完整程序保存为 src/main.rs：

use ankiforge::{BuildOptions, Note, Project};


fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut project = Project::new("spanish")?.default_deck("Spanish");
    project.add("es:hola", Note::basic("hola", "hello"))?;
    let output = project.build(BuildOptions::to("spanish.apkg"))?;
    println!("{}", output.artifact().path().display());
    Ok(())
}
终端窗口
cargo run

程序写出持久保存的 spanish.apkg。在 Anki 中打开并导入后，可在 Spanish 牌组中学习 hola → hello。导出不需要安装 Anki。

命名空间 spanish 和稳定键 es:hola 在之后的内容修改中标识这条笔记。也可以下载本站 Basic 示例。

继续学习
章节：继续学习

JSON 到 Anki 示例提供完整的媒体与更新任务。

pages.mainText:
生成 Anki 问答卡片与 Cloze 填空卡片

用代码批量生成 Anki 问答（Basic）卡片和 Cloze 填空（挖空）卡片，无需在 Anki 中逐张添加。Basic 笔记有正面和背面。Cloze 笔记针对每个受支持的填空编号生成一张卡片。本例用 Rust 创建两条笔记和三张卡片。Python 和 Node.js 提供相同的 Note.basic 与 Note.cloze 构造方法，参见 Python API 和 Node API。

在仓库根目录运行：

终端窗口
cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples

在 Anki 中打开 target/docs-examples/cards.apkg。Basic 的问题为 hola；两张 Cloze 卡片分别隐藏 Madrid 和 Spain。

编写笔记
章节：编写笔记

此函数摘自完整可执行程序。其中的 verify 辅助函数检查成功输出的笔记、卡片与媒体数量。

    let mut project = Project::new("docs-spanish")?.default_deck("Spanish");

为 Anki 卡片添加图片与音频 把图片和音频打包进生成的 Anki 卡片，例如带发音音频的单词卡或示意图题目。Anki Forge 将你提供的文件复制进 APKG；生成音频或图片（例如语音合成）需要使用其他工具。示例使用 Rust；下文的批量导入也给出了 Python 和 Node.js 调用。 Media 值拥有不可变快照。使用 Media::file 导入文件，或通过带显式 MIME 类型的 Media::bytes 导入原生字节。成功导入后，修改或删除源文件都不会改变该资源。克隆共享存储，可跨项目使用。 运行媒体流程 章节：运行媒体流程 在仓库根目录运行： 终端窗口 cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_media 该流程使用仓库 PNG/WAV 测试素材，写出包含一条笔记、一张卡片和三个资源的 media.apkg。第二个示例自行生成小图像和音频，包含 CSS 引用及显式声明的媒体，并写出 spanish-media.apkg。 fn media(output: &Path, image: &Path, sound: &Path) -> anyhow::Result<()> { let image = Media::file(image)?.with_export_name("cell.png")?; let sound = Media::file(sound)?; let mut project = Project::new("docs-media")?; project.add("cell", Note::basic(image.image(), sound.sound()))?; let css = Media::bytes(b".card { color: navy; }".to_vec(), "text/css")? .with_export_name("course.css")?; project.add_asset(css)?; let built = project.build(BuildOptions::to(output.join("media.apkg")))?; verify(&built, 1, 1, 3)?; Ok(()) } 组合内容与显式资源 章节：组合内容与显式资源 这份完整程序使用 fixtures/pixel.png、fixtures/silence.wav 和 fixtures/labels.woff。在应用中请传入自己的源路径。测试字体是仓库中允许再分发的测试用字体。 use ankiforge::{BuildOptions, Content, Field, Media, NoteType, Project, Template}; fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> { let image = Media::file("fixtures/pixel.png")?.with_export_name("badge.png")?; let sound = Media::file("fixtures/silence.wav")?; let font = Media::file("fixtures/labels.woff")?.with_export_name("labels.woff")?; let model = NoteType::builder("media-card") .field(Field::new("front")) .field(Field::new("back")) .template(Template::new("card") .front(r#"{{front}}"#) .back("{{FrontSide}}
{{back}}")) .css("@font-face { font-family: labels; src: url('labels.woff'); } .card { font-family: labels; }") .asset(font) .asset(image.clone()) .build()?; let mut project = Project::new("media-guide")?; project.add("cell", model.note() .field("front", Content::sequence([Content::text("Cell "), image.image()])) .field("back", sound.sound()))?; let output = project.build(BuildOptions::to("media-guide.apkg"))?; assert_eq!(output.report().counts().media, 3); Ok(()) } 类型化的 image() 和 sound() 值会保留依赖直至导出。手写 HTML、CSS 或脚本引用需要 builder.asset(media) 或 project.add_asset(media)；库不会从任意字符串推断文件内容。即使没有可被静态识别的引用，显式资源仍会被包含。 向 with_export_name 传入原始文件名。类型化声音引用在渲染时会转义 HTML 实体，因此 tone©.mp3 仍引用该原名资源。不要预先转义文件名。声音文件名中的百分号和片段字符保持字面含义，并不是 URL 路径。 名称、MIME 与预算 章节：名称、MIME 与预算 默认导出名称由内容决定，与源路径无关。需要固定文件名时，应在创建引用前使用 with_export_name。重命名某个克隆不会改变之前的克隆或内容节点。 名称不能包含路径、控制字符或不可移植的保留名称。冲突检查使用 Unicode NFC 加大小写折叠：仅大小写或规范化形式不同也会冲突。名称与内容完全相同的重复操作具有幂等性；同名不同内容会失败，不留下部分注册状态。 包括扩展名在内的完整导出文件名最多为 255 个 UTF-8 字节。Project 与模板包的 JSON Schema 检查文件名语法和字符数；加载器还检查字节预算。例如，重复 128 次的 é 能通过 schema 字符限制，却占 256 字节，加载时返回 MEDIA.EXPORT_NAME_INVALID。构建前通过 tools::load_project 或 NoteType::from_bundle 校验完整输入。 MIME 语法必须与可识别的内容一致。原生字节没有 64 KiB 的内联限制。默认导入预算为每个资源 256 MiB；file_with_limits 和 bytes_with_limits 在读取前接收 MediaLimits { max_bytes }。大快照可能写入临时存储，并在最后一个所有者消失后清理。快照所有权不保证在源文件同时被修改的导入过程中获得原子的文件系统视图。 Project JSON 解码内联 bytes 数组时使用相同的默认单资源预算。遇到首个超限字节便停止，不再收集剩余数组，并保留带限制和已观察字节数的 MediaError。拒绝时的计数是下界，并非尚未读取数组的总大小。 有效的媒体包并不证明所有 Anki 客户端都能播放其编解码格式。请在目标客户端测试图片、声音和字体。参见排查问题。 类型化图片与声音的使用 章节：类型化图片与声音的使用 构造函数保持不会失败。Project::add 检查导入时保留的 MIME：图片要求 image/*，声音引用接受 audio/* 和 video/*。application/octet-stream、文本、字体和 PDF 的类型化用法会返回 NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID；用于原始 HTML/CSS 时应注册为显式资源。有效但未知的图片或视频 MIME 声明可以通过类别校验，但这并不认证解码器或播放器支持这些字节。重命名文件不会改变已保留的 MIME。构建仍会探测暂存字节并独立校验导出扩展名：名为 wrong.mp3 的 PNG 可以通过图片添加，却在构建时返回 MEDIA.DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH。 批量媒体导入 章节：批量媒体导入 这些方法已包含在公开 0.3.1 包中。 以受限并发导入一组文件，保持输入顺序，并保留拥有所有权的媒体快照供之后导出： use ankiforge::Media; let images = Media::files(["first.png", "second.png"])?; Node 使用 await Media.files(['first.png', 'second.png'])；Python 使用 Media.files(['first.png', 'second.png'])。 批量行为与预算 章节：批量行为与预算 Rust 使用 Media::files(paths)，Node 使用 await Media.files(paths)，Python 使用 Media.files(paths)，按输入顺序导入文件，每次调用最多四个工作线程。少于 16 个文件时串行运行。Rust 还提供 files_with_limits；Node 和 Python 接受与 file 相同的限制。限制按每个资源计算。若某项导入失败，调用会等待已启动的工作完成、释放此批次的快照，并返回输入顺序中的第一个错误。已有媒体所有者继续有效。Python 在导入期间释放 GIL；Node 在事件循环之外执行工作。单文件导入仍立即产生拥有所有权的快照；调用方必须选择批量方法才能获得导入并发。 存活快照共享进程级 64 MiB 内存预算。单个大于 1 MiB 的资源仍流式写入临时文件。编码媒体在每次预备处理中共享延迟分配的 16 MiB 缓冲池，池满后写入临时存储。这些预算不包含其他工作内存，也不是 RSS 上限；并发构建各自可以拥有编码池。 查看 Markdown 编辑此页 上一页 生成 Anki 问答卡片与 Cloze 填空卡片 下一页 自定义笔记类型 Anki Forge：以 Rust 为核心的开源 Anki 牌组生成库。 文章 RSS MIT 许可证 AI 文档索引

"""Generate and review an answer-only update from caller-parsed JSON."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from ankiforge import BuildOptions, CompareOptions, Content, Media, Note, Project


def project(source: Path, version: str) -> Project:
    data = json.loads((source / version).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    image = Media.file(source / 'cell.png')
    audio = Media.file(source / 'tone.wav')
    result = Project(data['namespace'], default_deck=data['deck'])
    for row in data['notes']:
        front = Content.sequence([row['front'], image.image(), audio.sound()])
        result.add(row['id'], Note.basic(front, row['back']))
    return result


source = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'recipe')
output = Path(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'output/python')
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
baseline, candidate = output / 'v1.apkg', output / 'v2.apkg'
if baseline.exists() or candidate.exists():
    raise RuntimeError('Choose a fresh output directory; keep original releases')
project(source, 'v1.json').build(BuildOptions.to(baseline))
next_project = project(source, 'v2.json')
comparison = next_project.compare(CompareOptions.against(baseline))
(output / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparison.snapshot(), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
if not comparison.allows_publication:
    raise RuntimeError('Comparison policy blocked publication; inspect comparison.json')
prepared = next_project.prepare_publication(BuildOptions.to(candidate).update_from(baseline))
try:
    review = prepared.report.comparison
    if review is None:
        raise RuntimeError('Missing update comparison')
    (output / 'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(review.snapshot(), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    if not review.allows_publication:
        raise RuntimeError('Prepared candidate blocked; inspect review.json')
    result = prepared.publish()
    print(result.artifact.path)
finally:
    prepared.close()

landed.sectionText:
入口	行为
Media.file(path, *, limits=MediaLimits())	立即读取拥有所有权的快照
Media.bytes(data, media_type, *, limits=MediaLimits())	拥有带显式 MIME 类型的字节
media.with_export_name(name)	返回共享快照的新文件名值；之前的引用保留原名
media.filename, media.media_type, len(media)	只读快照元数据
media.image() / .sound()	保留快照的类型化内容
MediaLimits(max_bytes=256 << 20) 在创建快照前控制每次导入。大媒体可写入拥有所有权的临时存储。名称冲突在全部显式与自动收集资源间校验。
Note.image_occlusion(media) 返回 ImageOcclusionBuilder。链式调用 .mask(Mask.rect(key, x, y, width, height))、可选 .mode(OcclusionMode.HIDE_ONE_GUESS_ONE)，再调用 .build()。默认模式为 HIDE_ALL_GUESS_ONE。完成时解码图像，并校验稳定遮罩键和有限、位于图内的像素坐标。在返回的 Note 上可正常设置 header、back_extra 或 comments。生成的 image 与 occlusion 字段不能手动赋值。

landed.sectionText:
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError
project = Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'))
previous = project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'))
previous.artifact.close()
prepared = project.prepare_publication(
    BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').update_from('previous.apkg')
)
try:
    report = prepared.report  # observations; does not own the candidate
    if report.comparison is None or report.comparison.allows_publication:
        output = prepared.publish()
        output.artifact.close()  # persistent next.apkg remains
except BuildError as error:
    print(error.snapshot()['result'])  # actual publication/durability facts
    raise
finally:
    prepared.close()  # idempotent; deletes an unused candidate
一次发布尝试消耗所有者，包括策略或 I/O 失败。之后调用抛出 PreparedPublicationStateError，码为 BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE，原因是 closed 或 consumed；close 不取消已经运行的发布。相对路径在预备调用时绑定，Project 更改不能修改已审阅 APKG。报告关闭后仍可读，但不保留文件。改变选项或重试需重新预备。耗时不含审阅等待。晚期错误可能表示替换成功但持久性未确认；决定下一步前检查发布事实。要求原生绑定协议 1 和契约包 2.1.0；更旧的同版本二进制会被拒绝。

pages.mainText:
排查问题

使用失败操作的结构化 kind 和 code，结合来源链与观察结果进行排查。显示文本面向人类，可能变化。操作失败与比较已完成但策略阻止发布，是不同的结果。

安装
章节：安装
现象	检查
Rust 拒绝工具链	运行 rustc --version；使用 Rust 1.92+，并以 cargo tree -i ankiforge 检查安装版本
Node 无法加载原生包	运行 node -p "process.platform + '/' + process.arch" 和 npm ls ankiforge；用 npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1 重装
Node 报告原生层与包装层不匹配	使用匹配版本；从相同 registry 版本重装，或从同一源码目录重建两者
Python 无法加载扩展	运行 python -m pip show ankiforge 和 python -m pip debug --verbose；检查解释器以及 wheel 的 OS/CPU 标签
Python 选择源码发行包	选择匹配 wheel/解释器，或按源码构建配置编译器

参见已验证环境、Node 安装和 Python 安装。

模型与笔记
章节：模型与笔记
现象	修正
无效或空键	显式提供稳定键；显示名称另行设置
NOTE.KEY_DUPLICATE	每条逻辑源记录使用唯一键
NOTE.FIELD_UNKNOWN	按字段键赋值，不使用显示名称
NOTE.FIELD_REQUIRED	添加前填写声明了 required() 的字段
NOTE.MODEL_CONFLICT	同一模型键复用相同的已完成模型
模板引用错误	使用已声明键；检查原始源码字节范围
HTML 显示为原文	仅对有意加入的标记使用 Content::html
缺少 Cloze 卡片	使用 {{c1::answer}} 语法，支持编号 1–500

添加失败是原子的。修正笔记或模型后重试，不需要撤销部分模型或媒体注册。模型构建器必须先完成 .build()，才能创建自定义笔记。

媒体与模板
章节：媒体与模板
现象	修正
文件导入失败	检查调用 Media::file 时的源文件；之后删除源文件是支持的
MIME 与内容不匹配	向字节构造函数传入实际 MIME 类型
导出名称冲突	选择唯一可移植名称；大小写与 Unicode 规范化变体也冲突
缺失原始 HTML/CSS/脚本资源	使用模型 asset 或项目 add_asset 声明
媒体导入超限	导入前显式提高 MediaLimits.max_bytes
构建检查超限	为本次操作调整相关 InspectLimits 计数器
模板包加载失败	使用 bundle-v2、显式键、按键模板以及包内路径
IO 矩形失败	检查解码后显示尺寸、有限坐标和唯一遮罩键

所有笔记类型的文本默认行为一致。媒体节点收集依赖；手写文件名不会导入其字节。即使包有效，仍需对计划使用的编解码器和字体进行客户端播放检查。

更新与输出
章节：更新与输出

基线应为含完整身份证据的原始分发 APKG。Anki 重新导出的包不保留该证据。更新策略不能放行命名空间不匹配或证据损坏。

完成的比较可以有 allows_publication == false。选择显式风险类别放行前，检查原始发现项和证据。不要全部放行。若希望得到相同决策，必须向实际更新构建传入相同策略。在仅新建请求上设置策略会报错。

临时路径消失时，应将输出或产物所有者保留到全部读取者结束。报告和 JSON 快照不是所有者。持久化失败时，检查错误的发布阶段和持久性：目标已发布后也可能返回错误。参见输出保证。
